scope: Six existing profile/session/account/closure/review models; read-only metadata, unique keys, tenant relations, immutable messages, destruction approval and account closure guards. No new migration or claim of full R05 acceptance.

constraints.name: Account_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Account_ssoProviderId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("ssoProviderId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Account_sso_provider_match
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("left"("providerId", 4) = 'sso:'::text) AND ("ssoProviderId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("providerId" = ('sso:'::text || "ssoProviderId"))) OR (("left"("providerId", 4) <> 'sso:'::text) AND ("ssoProviderId" IS NULL))))

constraints.name: Account_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: AccountClosure_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: AccountClosure_time_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (("completedAt" >= "requestedAt"))

constraints.name: AccountClosure_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: AccountClosure_userId_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE ("userId")

constraints.name: ActivityReview_auditEvent_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId", "auditEventId", "recipientUserId") REFERENCES "AuditEvent"("tenantId", "serviceId", id, "actorId") ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReview_dates
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'requested'::text) AND ("respondedAt" IS NULL) AND ("closedAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'responded'::text) AND ("respondedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closedAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'resolved'::text) AND ("respondedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'cancelled'::text) AND ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ActivityReview_destroyApprover_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "destroyApproverId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReview_destruction
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("destructionStatus" = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'awaiting'::text, 'kept'::text, 'destroyed'::text])) AND (("destructionStatus" = 'destroyed'::text) = ("destroyedAt" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("destructionStatus" = 'destroyed'::text) = ("destroyApproverId" IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) OR (("retentionUntil" IS NULL) AND ("destructionStatus" = 'none'::text)))))

constraints.name: ActivityReview_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: ActivityReview_recipient_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "recipientId", "recipientUserId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id, "userId") ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReview_requester_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "requesterId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReview_service_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReview_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'responded'::text, 'resolved'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (version > 0) AND ((char_length(title) >= 1) AND (char_length(title) <= 200))))

constraints.name: ActivityReviewMessage_author_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "authorId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ActivityReviewMessage_kind
constraints.definition: CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['request'::text, 'response'::text, 'resolve'::text, 'cancel'::text])))

constraints.name: ActivityReviewMessage_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: ActivityReviewMessage_review_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "reviewId") REFERENCES "ActivityReview"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Session_activeCompanyId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("activeCompanyId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: Session_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Session_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: User_email_normalized
constraints.definition: CHECK ((email = lower(email)))

constraints.name: User_jobTitle_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("jobTitle" IS NULL) OR (char_length("jobTitle") <= 100)))

constraints.name: User_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: User_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'closed'::text])))

triggers.name: Account_derive_sso_provider
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "Account_derive_sso_provider" BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF "providerId", "ssoProviderId" ON public."Account" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION derive_account_sso_provider()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.derive_account_sso_provider()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW."ssoProviderId" := CASE WHEN left(NEW."providerId",4)='sso:' THEN substring(NEW."providerId" from 5) ELSE NULL END;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.name: Account_password_history
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "Account_password_history" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF password ON public."Account" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_credential_change()

triggers.name: account_closure_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER account_closure_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."AccountClosure" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION preserve_account_closure()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_account_closure()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACCOUNT_CLOSURE_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$

triggers.name: activity_review_message_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER activity_review_message_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."ActivityReviewMessage" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_activity_review_message()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_activity_review_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND current_setting('app.activity_review_destroy', true)='on'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ActivityReview" r WHERE r."tenantId"=OLD."tenantId" AND r.id=OLD."reviewId" AND r."destructionStatus"='awaiting')
 THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'activity review messages are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END; $function$
